(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix recording rules group set. Recording rules pre-compute frequently used or computationally heavy PromQL expressions into new metrics. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/data-transformation/metric-rules/recording-rules/.
groups  nested SET computed
    description: The rule groups of the set, in no particular order.
groups.interval  tftypes.Number computed
    description: How often rules in the group are evaluated (in seconds). Default is 60 seconds.
groups.limit  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Limits the number of alerts an alerting rule and series a recording-rule can produce. 0 is no limit.
groups.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The (unique) rule-group name.
groups.rules  nested LIST computed
    description: List of rules.
groups.rules.evaluation_delay_ms  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Delays the rule's evaluation (in milliseconds) so late-arriving data is ingested first. Must be between 0 and 1800000 (30 minutes). When omitted, no delay is configured; an explicit 0 is a distinct, persisted value. Removing the attribute clears the delay.
groups.rules.expr  tftypes.String computed
    description: The PromQL expression to evaluate. Every evaluation cycle this is evaluated at the current time, and the result recorded as a new set of time series with the metric name as given by 'record'.
groups.rules.labels  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Labels to add or overwrite before storing the result. The labels are computed: removing the attribute does not clear them on its own, so set `labels = {}` to clear them.
groups.rules.record  tftypes.String computed
    description: The name of the time series to output to. Must be a valid metric name.
id  tftypes.String required
    description: Unique identifier.
name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The name of the rule group. Overrides the name specified in the YAML if provided.
yaml_content  tftypes.String computed
    description: YAML specification of rules. Cannot be used together with `groups`. Keys are the lowercased field names (for example the evaluation delay is `evaluationdelayms`). Unrecognized keys are ignored silently, so prefer `groups` if you want your attribute names validated.
